name: Sugamo Mutsuki
source:
Main heroine. A phantasmagorical, beautiful young girl who loiters alone in a classroom after school.

The protagonist finds himself intensely attracted to her girlish and pure freshness; at the same time, her seraphic aura frightens him.

[Translated from [url=http://craftwork.product.co.jp/CATALOG/adieu/chara/chara_01.html]official profile[/url].]

She resembles the angel present in the protagonist's nightmares to an alarming degree.
